_source: CORE Math Pacing Guide 7th Grade - Open Up Resources with Open Up (OUR Math), uploaded 8/31/26, transcribed by week. Same segment-list schema as Grades K-6's our_math_g{K,1,2,3,4,5,6}_weeks.json.
_note: Module = Unit (OUR Math's own numbering), Unit = Section (hyphenated when a week's lessons span multiple sections within the same Unit and every section involved has real lesson content that week). Course finishes at week 35, same shape as Grades 1-6: week 36's header reads 'Unit 9 Assessments & Review' but the body is three generic dice/card review games (Dice Integers Challenge, Card Proportional Relationships, Dice Probability Experiment) unrelated to any specific Unit 9 content and with no lesson or assessment link - matching Appendix A's own LP10 line for this same slot, which prints the identical bare 'Unit 9 Assessments & Review — [Unit 9 Assessments]' header with no lesson content either. No key for week 36 here, per the standing no-M|U|L-content rule. Every 'Unit N Pre Assessment' / 'Unit N Pre-Unit Assessment' (weeks 1, 4, 7, 10, 14, 18, 23, 27) is a diagnostic placement test and is excluded entirely, per the precedent set at every prior grade and matching the fact that Appendix A's own bullets never mention them either. 'Unit N Mid Unit Assessment' (weeks 20, 30) collapses to the base 'Unit N Assessment' tag per the standing Mid-/End-of- rule - this is the same omitted-tag divergence flagged at Grade 6: Appendix A's own bullets for both weeks reproduce the same lesson numbers but never print the Mid Unit Assessment tag itself (confirmed at both weeks it appears), so this does not affect the closed-range comparison below. Two guide header typos, both reproduced verbatim in Appendix A's own stored bullets (the same downstream-artifact pattern documented at Grade 5 ELA and Grade 6 Math): week 9's header reads 'Unit 3 | Section B | Lessons 7-9 & Section | Lessons 10-11' with the second section letter dropped entirely - the lesson URLs (unit-3/section-c/lesson-10, lesson-11) confirm Section C, so this is transcribed as 'B-C'; and weeks 24's header re-uses 'Unit 6' for what the lesson URLs and titles (Adjacent Angles, Nonadjacent Angles, etc., all unit-7/section-a) confirm is Unit 7 Section A - transcribed as Unit 7. Body/URL wins per the standing rule in both cases. Confirmed against Appendix A's Grade 7 OUR Math bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md, which for this grade already carry the same per-week breakdown as the guide itself (unlike the compressed one-line-per-LP ranges at other grades) - every closed range agrees exactly across all 10 LPs (including both header-typo weeks, which Appendix A reproduces identically), zero real boundary mismatches. Appendix A's own LP groupings shift the weeks between LP4/LP5 and LP8/LP9 relative to a strict 4-week-per-LP read (LP4 gets only 3 Math bullets, weeks 13-15; LP5 picks up at week 16; similarly LP8 gets only 3 bullets, weeks 28-30, and LP9 picks up at week 31) - a window-vs-prose grouping difference, not a lesson-range defect; the guide's own week numbers are unaffected and are what this file transcribes. Lesson accounting is contiguous from 1 with no gaps or duplicates across all 9 Units (13, 15, 11, 16, 17, 23, 17, 20, 13 lessons), 145 lessons total.
